    def _dropedge_adjacency(self, adjacency):
        # The sole experimental change: sample unique undirected edges after
        # supervised-edge masking, then normalize the retained topology afresh.
        # Both directions share one Bernoulli draw; all propagation layers use
        # the same resulting graph. Evaluation consumes no randomness.
        if not self.training:
            return adjacency
        indices = adjacency.to_sparse_coo().coalesce().indices()
        rows, cols = indices
        forward = (rows < self.nusers) & (cols > self.nusers)
        users, items = rows[forward], cols[forward]
        keep = torch.rand(users.shape, device=users.device) < self.dropedge_keep_probability
        users, items = users[keep], items[keep]
        rows = torch.cat((users, items))
        cols = torch.cat((items, users))
        degree = torch.bincount(rows, minlength=adjacency.shape[0]).to(
            dtype=adjacency.dtype
        ).clamp_min(1)
        values = degree[rows].rsqrt() * degree[cols].rsqrt()
        return torch.sparse_coo_tensor(
            torch.stack((rows, cols)), values, adjacency.shape,
            device=adjacency.device,
        ).coalesce().to_sparse_csr()
